events.title: Alter Bridge
events.venue: Martin Woldson Theater at the Fox
events.blurb: The rock band brings its What Lies Within tour to the restored art deco Fox, with Big Wreck and Tim Montana opening.
events.blurbEs: La banda de rock trae su gira What Lies Within al restaurado teatro art déco Fox, con Big Wreck y Tim Montana como teloneros.

events.title: Jay Chandrasekhar
events.blurb: The Super Troopers director and Broken Lizard comic does stand-up, with two shows each night.
events.blurbEs: El director de Super Troopers y comediante de Broken Lizard hace stand-up, con dos funciones cada noche.

events.title: Spokane Chiefs vs. Kelowna Rockets
events.blurb: Saturday night WHL hockey on Fred Meyer Shop With The Chiefs Night, which includes a $1,000 shopping spree giveaway.
events.blurbEs: Hockey de la WHL el sábado por la noche en la Fred Meyer Shop With The Chiefs Night, con el sorteo de una compra de $1,000.

events.title: Numerica Tree Lighting Celebration
events.blurb: Food trucks, community performances and the downtown tree lighting at the Numerica Skate Ribbon. Free hot chocolate and light-up wands while supplies last.
events.blurbEs: Food trucks, presentaciones de la comunidad y el encendido del árbol en la pista Numerica Skate Ribbon. Chocolate caliente y varitas luminosas gratis hasta agotar existencias.

events.title: Kendall Yards Winter Festival Christmas Market
events.blurb: Local vendors in a heated tent, Santa, two live reindeer, carolers, live music and kids' activities along Summit Parkway. Fireworks on Saturday evening.
events.blurbEs: Vendedores locales en una carpa con calefacción, Santa, dos renos de verdad, villancicos, música en vivo y actividades para niños en Summit Parkway. Fuegos artificiales el sábado por la noche.

events.title: A Celtic Christmas: Ireland with Michael
events.blurb: Irish singer and PBS host Michael Londra mixes carols, traditional tunes and stories, joined by local musicians and Haran School of Irish Dance.
events.blurbEs: El cantante irlandés y presentador de PBS Michael Londra combina villancicos, música tradicional e historias, con músicos locales y la Haran School of Irish Dance.
